stock.description: Jinmao Property Services Co., Limited functions as an investment holding enterprise, with its principal activities centered on providing property management services across mainland China. The company's diverse service offerings also extend to technology development and support, real estate agency work, urban area operation, and smart community oversight. Established in 1993 and based in Beijing, the People's Republic of China, the firm previously operated under the name Jinmao Property Development Co., Ltd. before its official renaming to Jinmao Property Services Co., Limited in October 2021. It operates as a constituent entity within the China Jinmao Holdings Group Limited.
